segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation and good results, though a few reviewers, some not otherwise describing their skin as sensitive, report itching, redness, or breakouts significant enough to stop using it.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some in their 40s, report strong hydration and skin that feels bouncier and less tight.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one who is also acne-prone, report the serum absorbs well and does not cause breakouts.
segments.mature: The reviewer who specifically describes mature skin reports it works well as part of a nightly routine and helps her makeup apply more smoothly.
segments.oily: The reviewer with oily skin says she prefers using the serum alone, without the line's heavier moisturizer, because it plumps her skin well on its own.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, firmer skin, and reduced wrinkles, in some cases within a few weeks; several others say they noticed little to no difference in effectiveness despite continued use.
concerns.dehydration: The great majority of reviewers describe the serum as hydrating, leaving skin feeling smooth and plump without stickiness; a few say they did not notice much change in hydration.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her skin became red, irritated, and broke out after several weeks of use and she had to stop.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report dark spots and discoloration becoming lighter or less noticeable after a few weeks of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers, including one who is combination and acne-prone, report no breakouts and even some clearing of acne; one reviewer's skin broke out significantly and became irritated.
